connector.name: Claude Remind MCP
connector.registryDescription: Search past Claude Code conversations. Local BM25 over JSONL with one-click claude --resume.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package claude-remind-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the emretheus account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.description: Override where the index is persisted (default: ~/.claude-remind). Must be an absolute path.
